channel.description: Latest articles from Wisconsin Newspaper Association (wnanews.com)

item.title: Wisconsin’s best winter stargazing parks
item.description: From Northwoods islands to Driftless hilltops, Wisconsin has the best parks for magical stargazing -- and maybe even a northern lights surprise.

item.title: The Gazette marks 180 years in Janesville
item.description: Janesville’s daily newspaper celebrated its 180th birthday, Thursday, Aug. 14, 2025. A story in the Jan. 23, 2026 issue of The Gazette marked the milestone.

item.title: Ardith Carlton joins Northwoods River News, Lakeland Times as reporter
item.description: A new reporter has joined the team of The Northwoods River News and The Lakeland Times: Ardith Carlton will be based out of the River News office, 236 S. item.title: Lawmakers reach deal to save WisEye
item.description: Legislative leaders have reached a tentative bipartisan agreement to fund WisconsinEye, the state’s version of C-SPAN, over a month after it went dark.

item.title: Bill bars secrecy deals with data centers
item.description: A new Republican bill introduced this week bars data center developers from entering into agreements intended to conceal information about a project from the public.

item.title: Advertising Sessions: Kevin Berrier to present at 2026 WNA Convention
item.description: Kevin Berrier describes his upcoming appearances at the 2026 Wisconsin Newspaper Association Convention

item.title: UW Center for Journalism Ethics presents free ‘Reporting on Immigration in Times of Crisis: Wisconsin and Beyond’ event on March 3
item.description: Join the UW Center for Journalism Ethics in hearing from 2026 journalist-in-residence Melissa Sanchez, immigration and labor reporter at ProPublica, about her work covering Wisconsin dairy farms, ICE activity in Chicago and more during “Reporting on Immigration in Times of Crisis: Wisconsin and Beyond” from 6:30-8 p.m. on Tuesday, March 3, 2026.

item.title: Reporters: Apply now for six new environmental reporting positions with the Ag & Water Desk
item.description: The Mississippi River Basin Ag & Water Desk, an environmental news network covering America's largest watershed, is seeking talented journalists to join six newsrooms through Report for America's 2026 class. The application deadline is Feb. 16, 2026.

item.title: Pulitzer-Prize winning editor joins Gazette as president, publisher
item.description: Adams MultiMedia, the parent company of The Gazette, announced Jan. 27 that Richard Green, a longtime media executive and editor, will be regional president and publisher of The Cedar Rapids Gazette and 11 other community newspaper titles in Iowa.

item.title: Wisconsin’s state and local tax burden remains at record low
item.description: Wisconsin’s tax burden remained at an all-time low in 2025, as its residents’ combined incomes grew at the same rate as state and local tax collections.
